verdict.rationale: A marketplace of ready-made scrapers is a fair question for a web-scraping tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only primitives for building your own scraper (CSS/XPath/LLM extraction, schemas, the CLI). The skill package is for AI coding assistants, and the community docs hub offers setup guides; neither is a scraper marketplace, so nothing in the pack shows one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
